column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹72.00 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹ 107.50
lakh and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹35.50 lakh. Increase
was attributed to
contract services, office
expenses and material
and supply. Decrease
was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).

Surrender of the entire
provision have not
been intimated (July
2024).
